title: Clinical Director
description:
Acorn Health is an Applied Behavioral Analysis (ABA) treatment provider dedicated to providing the best quality care for our clients. We aim to continually establish best-in-class standards in integrity and quality for not only ourselves, but also in the field of ABA. We work courageously and with accountability to focus on the individuality of each child, collaborate with client families, and generate permanence in client outcomes. We strive to hire and to invest in our greatest asset - our employees, who are the heart of Acorn Health.

Acorn Health is a standard-setting family of ABA treatment providers. We believe the best employees want to work with companies who share their beliefs, and that is true for families who entrust us with children they love. Every day and every interaction, we strive to demonstrate our Five Core Values.

Acorn Health is looking for a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) to join us as a Clinical Director as we increase access to care in the Miramar area!

We also have additional clinics in Coral Gables and beyond!

We believe in clinical quality. The compensation reflected in the job post includes the base level of a bonus package tied to your delivery of clinical impact hours. We look forward to sharing more details with you should you choose to seek partnership with Acorn Health.

Every day and every interaction, we strive to demonstrate our Five Core Values.

  • Authenticity: We present our true, consistent selves. Everyone hungers for genuine connections.
  • Accountability: We keep our promises and can be trusted with the life and future of a child.
  • Teamwork: The best outcomes are produced by people who collaborate with enthusiasm.
  • Growth: We know the needs of children and their families are unique and ever-changing.
  • Hustle: In autism care and treatment, time is always of the essence. We do things now.

You’ll have the opportunity to work in a team-oriented environment and engage in a wide range of activities, focused on providing behavior analytic assessment and treatment services in our clinical centers, at client homes, and/or in community settings.

What our Clinical Directors do:

  • Responsible for driving the execution of key service, quality and growth initiatives
  • Manage or assist in managing the day-to-day operations of all services, including staff and client scheduling.
  • Execute clinical policies and procedures.
  • Promote a therapeutic environment for all clients, ensuring client input is fully considered when developing and carrying out treatment plans.
  • Provide clinical management and oversight to a team of BCBAs, BCaBAs, and RBTs.
  • Problem solve issues with supervisees when insufficient progress toward client goals/outcomes is observed via a review of relevant behavioral data.
  • Conduct staff and caregiver trainings.
  • Regularly reference behavior analytic literature and attend relevant conference and workshops in order to best inform evidence-based treatment.
  • Complete annual performance evaluations for all BCBAs, BCaBAs, and ABA Supervisors to determine potential for improvement and ensure treatment integrity.
  • Pinpoint performances that allow supervisees to achieve measurable outcomes valuable to the client.
  • Maintain a reduced clinical caseload, involving direct assessment and treatment of clients.
  • Participate actively in hiring process of behavior technicians, BCBAs, BCaBAs, and ABA Supervisors.
  • Handle sensitive employee relations issues with integrity, either individually or with the assistance of Human Resources
  • Communicate with Acorn Health administrative teams including Admissions, Payroll, Finance, Billing and Human Resources to assist in staff and client records management and payer relationships.
  • Attend meetings as required by the Regional Clinical Director.

Why work for Acorn Health:

  • Incentive Bonus
  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • Medical, dental and vision insurance
  • Retirement Plan
  • Life insurance, long term and short term disability
  • CEU opportunities
  • Professional development funds
  • Career development opportunities, including Acorn’s Leadership Development Institute
  • Opportunities to collaborate with and learn from our Clinical Advisory Board
  • Positive and collaborative environment
  • Balanced caseloads and flexible work environment
  • Supportive administrative back office
  • Compensation Range: $90k-$117,600/year.

You're perfect for the position if you have:

  • A master’s degree in ABA or a related field
  • An active Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) certification
  • 3 years of experience as a practicing BCBA
  • Knowledge of best practices in the treatment of autism
  • Experience working with children, adolescents, young adults, and their families
  • Experience serving in a leadership/management role for an ABA provider
  • Experience managing teams, projects, and meetings
  • Proficiency with ABA data collection and practice management systems such as Central Reach
  • Are able to communicate effectively, verbally and in writing, in English
  • Have reliable transportation, a valid driver’s license, and satisfactory driving record
  • Meet the physical requirements of the position, to include lifting of packages, or equipment, and accessing non-barrier free premises
  • Enjoy working in an interdisciplinary team approach to develop and implement client treatment plans
  • Have strong organizational skills, are detail-oriented, able to maintain records, prepare reports and reliably develop timely correspondence related to work
  • Are able to pass a background check
  • Have the flexibility to work independently when needed, but also enjoy working as a part of the larger team

Note: This position requires a Board Certified Behavior Analysis (BCBA) from the BACB. Data and Business Analyst candidates cannot be considered due to payer restrictions.

Background Screening Requirement
This position requires a Level II background screening in accordance with Florida law. As a qualified employer, we are required to provide applicants with access to the State of Florida’s background‑screening education and awareness resource.

title: PKI Service Desk Technician
description:
Link Solutions is seeking a PKI Service Desk Technician to join our team in Sierra Vista, AZ.

  • U.S. Citizen with an active DoW Secret Clearance
  • IAT Level II Certification equivalent or higher
  • Mid Shift (see details below)
  • Non-remote (relocation incentive available)

The PKI Service Desk Technician will provide technical and system support for the U.S. Army Network Enterprise Technology Command (NETCOM) at Fort Huachuca, AZ. You will work across multiple technical teams, mission partners, and senior leaders to maintain secure workforce access, support enterprise PKI operations, manage IT assets, and assist with the deployment and sustainment of critical network and cybersecurity services.

In this position, you will provide Common Access Card (CAC), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and Registration Authority/Local Registration Authority (RA/LRA) support functions related to the issuance, renewal, revocation, suspension, recovery, and management of NIPRNet Alternate Smart Card Logon (ASCL), SIPRNet, and Deployed Forces network tokens. You will support PKI credentialing operations to ensure authorized users maintain secure access to Army networks, systems, applications, and mission-critical resources.

Become an integral part of a professionally diverse team while working at an industry-leading organization where work-life balance and employee development are prioritized. This opportunity offers exposure to innovative technologies, professional growth, and the ability to directly support Army cybersecurity operations and national defense missions.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Provide Tier I and Tier II technical support for PKI-related incidents, service requests, and security access issues.
  • Respond to and resolve daily Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and card-access support requests, including user permissions, certificate issues, account access, and application-related access problems.
  • Process, issue, renew, revoke, and maintain digital certificates throughout the certificate lifecycle.
  • Support SSL/TLS certificate requests, installations, renewals, and troubleshooting across servers, applications, and network devices.
  • Manage privileged user accounts, including account creation, modification, renewal, reinstatement, and deactivation in accordance with security policies.
  • Monitor PKI infrastructure and associated systems to ensure operational availability, performance, and compliance with security requirements.
  • Troubleshoot certificate validation, authentication, encryption, and smart card-related issues for end users and system administrators.
  • Evaluate certificate health and identify issues related to expiration, revocation, trust chains, configuration, and compliance requirements.
  • Assist users with certificate enrollment, installation, renewal, and recovery procedures.
  • Maintain accurate records of certificate inventories, system configurations, and support activities.
  • Support and process PKI service requests, escalating complex technical issues to senior engineers or administrators as required.
  • Assist with routine system maintenance, software patches, upgrades, and version updates for PKI and access-control systems.
  • Participate in the deployment, testing, and implementation of new PKI applications, tools, and services.
  • Implement approved changes to PKI infrastructure in accordance with established change management and security procedures.
  • Review system logs, alerts, and audit records to identify and resolve potential security or operational issues.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity, network, server, and application teams to troubleshoot and resolve PKI-related incidents.
  • Support compliance, audit, and security initiatives by maintaining documentation and adhering to organizational policies and industry best practices.

Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job.

Shift Information:

  • Initial training period: Two (2) weeks on the Day Shift
  • Mid Shift (Fixed Schedule)
  • Sunday – Wednesday
  • 10:00 PM – 8:00 AM (Local Time)
  • U.S. Citizen with an active DoW Secret Clearance.
  • IAT Level II Certification equivalent or higher per DoD 8570/DoD 8140 (CompTIA Security+ CE, CCNA Security, GICSP, GSEC, SSCP, etc.).
  • Associate degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related field, or a minimum of two (2+) years of relevant experience supporting enterprise IT systems.
  • Experience supporting Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) environments, including troubleshooting certificate, authentication, access, and encryption-related issues.
  • Experience monitoring, maintaining, and assessing the performance, availability, and security of PKI systems and services.
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, identity and access management, and best practices for protecting sensitive data and PKI infrastructure.
  • Current Computing Environment (CE) certification, or the ability to obtain the required certification within 90 days of hire.

Preferred:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience supporting information technology systems within a Department of Defense (DoD) or other regulated government environment.
  • Demonstrated troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues in mission-critical environments.
  • Self-motivated professional with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision.
  • Experience providing technical support and customer service for mission-critical systems, including support for senior leaders and VIP users.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively interact with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize competing requirements in a fast-paced operational environment.

title: Electrical Engineer III
description:
This position requires that you must be a US Citizen for consideration and meet all Federal Contractor employee requirements. Nomad GCS does not support the H1B Visa for this position.



Position: Electrical Engineer III
Division: Innovative Solutions Group
Department: Electrical Engineering
Status: Full-time


Nomad GCS is currently seeking a Level III Electrical Engineer. Please note the Level III Expectation in red below.


Overview: Nomad Global Communication Solutions (Nomad GCS) is a leading provider of communication and response products serving a wide range of customers. Our purpose is to be the solution when every minute matters. We are seeking Electrical Engineers to help design, develop, and support the electrical systems that power Nomad’s mission-critical platforms.


Electrical Engineers at Nomad GCS are responsible for the design, documentation, testing, and support of electrical systems including low-voltage (12V/24V DC), high-voltage (120V/240V AC), control systems, power distribution, communications, and integration with mechanical and IT subsystems. Engineers collaborate closely with Manufacturing, IT Integration, Quality, and Program Management to ensure safe, reliable, and manufacturable designs.


Depending on level (I–V), Engineers progress from learning foundational engineering practices and supporting designs to independently leading complex system architectures, mentoring others, and driving technical strategy across the organization.


Career Growth: Electrical Engineers at Nomad GCS progress through five levels based on demonstrated technical mastery, independence, leadership, and impact. Advancement is supported through mentorship, project ownership, and alignment with Nomad’s Core Values.


Organizational Structure: Engineering is organized into Teams and Disciplines within the Innovative Solutions Division.


Teams:

o Team 1 – Standards and Modularity: Builds and maintains engineering standards, modules, templates, and rules enabling repeatability and scale.

o Team 2 – Design: Executes project-level engineering using established standards and less complex custom configurations.

o Team 3 – Advanced: Develops novel systems and resolves first-of-kind engineering challenges.

o Team 4 – Manufacturing & Industrial Engineering: Ensures manufacturability, safety, engineering intent, efficiency, and continuous improvement throughout Production.


Disciplines:

o Mechanical Engineering

o Electrical Engineering (where this role is located)

o IT Engineering

o Human Factors Engineering

o Software Engineering

An Electrical Engineer may be temporarily assigned to one or more of the four Teams and support Standards and Modularity, Design Engineering, Advanced Engineering, and/or Manufacturing & Industrial Engineering.


Core Responsibilities – All Levels:

  • Design, develop, and support electrical systems for Nomad vehicles and platforms.
  • Create and maintain electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and CAD documentation.
  • Ensure designs comply with applicable electrical codes, safety standards, and customer requirements.
  • Support manufacturing by answering technical questions, resolving build issues, and improving design clarity.
  • Participate in design reviews, testing, validation, and root cause analysis.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Mechanical Engineering, IT Integration, Human Factor Engineering, Software Engineering, Production, Quality, and Project Management teams.
  • Apply continuous improvement principles to improve product quality, reliability, and manufacturability.
  • Uphold and model Nomad Core Values in all work.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.


Level Expectations:

Electrical Engineer l – Entry / Developing

  • Support senior engineers with electrical design tasks and documentation.
  • Exposure to at least one full product lifecycle phase (design, build, test, or release).
  • Create and update schematics, wiring diagrams, and bills of material under supervision.
  • Hands-on experience with basic ECAD tools (schematics, wire harnesses, revisions).
  • Learn Nomad electrical standards, drawing conventions, and design processes.
  • Familiarity with standard Nomad equipment (multimeter, oscilloscope, power supplies) under guidance.
  • Assist with prototype builds, testing, and validation activities.
  • Experience following established procedures, checklists, and engineering change processes.
  • Respond to basic manufacturing questions with guidance.
  • Demonstrated ability to incorporate feedback and correct design or documentation errors.
  • Develop foundational knowledge of AC/DC systems, power distribution, grounding, and protection.
  • Work under close supervision while building technical competence and confidence.
  • Academic or project-based experience applying fundamental electrical theory to real hardware.
    • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related field or 2-5 years Electrical Engineering experience.
  • 0-2 years electrical engineering experience.

Progression signal: Learns quickly, reduces rework, and increasingly completes tasks correctly on the first pass.


Electrical Engineer ll – Independent Contributor

  • Independently design electrical subsystems and assemblies for assigned projects.
  • Experience owning electrical design tasks end-to-end for small to mid-sized subsystems.
  • Create complete, production-ready electrical drawings and documentation.
  • Hands-on involvement with prototype builds, bring-up, and failure investigation.
  • Experience releasing designs to manufacturing and supporting early production.
  • Regular use of applicable electrical codes and standards (e.g., NEC, UL, IEC) with minimal oversight. Apply electrical codes, standards, and best practices to designs.

title: Cloud Administrator
description:
Overview

The Cloud Administrator is responsible for the day-to-day administration, monitoring, maintenance, and optimization of the organization's cloud and hybrid infrastructure. This role supports Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, SaaS applications, and on-premises systems while ensuring high availability, security, compliance, and operational efficiency.

The Cloud Administrator works closely with infrastructure, cybersecurity, and business teams to maintain secure and reliable cloud services, troubleshoot technical issues, support end users, and assist with implementing new cloud technologies that align with business objectives.

Responsibilities

Essential Responsibilities

Cloud Administration

  • Administer, monitor, and maintain Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, SaaS applications, and hybrid cloud environments.
  • Configure cloud resources including virtual machines, storage accounts, networking, identity services, and cloud applications.
  • Monitor system performance, capacity, availability, and resource utilization to ensure optimal operation.
  • Assist with cloud migrations and implementation of new cloud services.

Identity & Access Management

  • Manage Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Active Directory), user accounts, group memberships, licensing, and authentication.
  • Configure and maintain Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Conditional Access Policies, and Single Sign-On (SSO).
  • Review and manage user permissions following least privileged security principles.

Security & Compliance

  • Support cloud security initiatives by monitoring security alerts, vulnerabilities, and health systems.
  • Assist in maintaining compliance with applicable regulatory and customer requirements, including CMMC Level 2, NIST 800-171, CUI, FedRAMP, and other applicable security frameworks.
  • Work with cybersecurity personnel to implement security best practices and remediation activities.

Backup & Disaster Recovery

  • Maintain cloud backup solutions and disaster recovery processes.
  • Perform backup validation and recovery testing to ensure business continuity.
  • Assist in disaster recovery planning and documentation.

Monitoring & Support

  • Monitor cloud environments for performance, outages, and operational issues.
  • Troubleshoot cloud infrastructure, Microsoft 365, networking, and SaaS application issues.
  • Provide Tier II/III technical support for cloud-related incidents and service requests.
  • Escalate complex issues as appropriate.

Documentation & Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain documentation for cloud configurations, procedures, and standards.
  • Recommend improvements that enhance security, efficiency, automation, and cost optimization.
  • Assist with evaluating new cloud technologies and solutions.

Collaboration

  • Partner with Infrastructure, Security, Help Desk, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable cloud services.
  • Support cloud-related projects and participate in technology initiatives.
  • Provide guidance and training to IT staff and end users as needed.

Qualifications

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of Microsoft Azure administration and Microsoft 365 services.
  • Experience supporting hybrid cloud and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, and Intune.
  • Understanding of cloud networking, storage, virtualization, and identity management.
  • Knowledge of cloud security principles and cybersecurity is the best practices.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Five or more years of Information Technology experience.
  • Three or more years administering Microsoft Azure environments.
  • Experience administering Microsoft 365 enterprise environments.
  • Experience supporting SaaS platforms and hybrid cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience with PowerShell or other scripting languages used for administration and automation.
  • Experience with Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, and Azure Monitor.
  • Familiarity with Azure Virtual Desktop is a plus.
  • Experience supporting manufacturing or aerospace environments preferred.

Preferred Certifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)
  • Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert (MS-102)
  • Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst (SC-200)
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500)
  • Microsoft Certified: Information Protection Administrator (SC-400)
  • ITIL Foundation Certification
  • CompTIA Security+
  • CISSP or CISM (preferred but not required)

title: Mechanical Engineer
description:
Your Opportunity

Our Buildings team is looking for a Project Mechanical Engineer. You will work with direct supervision and general direction on tasks and smaller projects, and as a team member of larger projects under the guidance of a Senior Engineer/Designer. You will assist in evaluating, selecting, specifying, and engineering certain Heating, Ventilating, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) building systems for a project verifying compliance with applicable codes and internal engineering standards / practices. You will perform a variety of tasks which may include Revit modeling, preparing design drawings, performing system calculations, ductwork design, piping design, specifying equipment, field survey work, and construction administration.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Work with a team of design colleagues to conceptualize and develop full documentation for new construction and renovation projects for multiple types of facilities such as: advanced technologies, industrial, healthcare, mission critical, higher education, research laboratories or similar applications.
  • Engage in the development of a design through sketches, electronic models, diagrams, and other visual formats.
  • Utilize Building Information Modeling (BIM) technologies in development of three-dimensional models of building’s mechanical systems.
  • Prepare and revise documentation in various mechanical phases including site plans, floor plans, diagrams, and details.
  • Participate in project coordination meetings with internal team members and/or external consultants, owner and contractor, sub-contractors, and vendors.
  • Participate in client contact on projects to establish design criteria, review design progress as well as providing support through construction administration.
  • Support the preparation and coordination of the project specifications with construction documents.
  • Work on multiple projects.
  • Conduct field surveys of existing conditions of building spaces.
  • Prepare field reports and punch lists.
  • Provide basic mentoring to junior staff.

Your Capabilities and Credentials

  • Requisite knowledge, interpretation, and application of mechanical codes, energy codes, NFPA codes, ASHRAE standards, and other building codes.
  • Strong understanding of all phases of project document production and the relationship between drawings and specifications.
  • Strong knowledge of mechanical systems, means and methods, materials, and industry standards.
  • Perform calculations using company standard software and proprietary manufacturer software (IESVE for HVAC, Trane Trace, and/or HAP).
  • Demonstrates technical writing ability to author a discipline specific Basis of Design.
  • Development of project job specific discipline specifications independently from a company master specification.

description:

Department: | Engine

Experience: | As per Company Recruitment & Promotion Experience Requirements

Description and Main Purpose of Job:
The Hotel & Boats Motorman is a specialized day-work rating responsible for maintaining small boat engines and providing technical support for hotel, galley, laundry, and waste management machinery. Operating under the Hotel Engineer, this role ensures the readiness of safety craft and the continuous operation of domestic services, and performs any additional general technical duties as reasonably required.

Main Duties and Responsibilities:

Marine Equipment & Operations: Maintain, troubleshoot, and test the engines and mechanical systems of lifeboats, Pascoe tenders, and Zodiacs. Perform bunkering of these crafts as needed and conduct dedicated morning pre-departure inspections for any boats scheduled for passenger or operational use that day.
Hotel, Galley & Laundry Equipment: Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on catering and domestic machinery located in galleys, pantries, and the laundry, and sanitize drinking water fountains.
Waste Systems Machinery: Operate and maintain food waste processing equipment (galley pulpers, piping circuits, and vacuum pumps) as well as garbage handling machinery (glass crushers, cardboard balers, and compactors).
Routine Rounds & Reporting: Conduct comprehensive daily and weekly (Sunday) inspection rounds across all assigned marine and hotel equipment. Complete mandatory checklists, maintain assigned workshops, and promptly report any defects to the Hotel Engineer.  Safety & Compliance: Strictly adhere to Permit to Work (PTW) and Lock-out/Tag-out (LOTO) procedures when intervening on mechanical or electrical equipment and ensure compliance with work and rest hour regulations.

Health, Safety and Environment Duties and Responsibilities:
All employees have a duty under Company Policies and VMS requirements to:
Participate in shipboard emergency duties and drills in accordance with the vessel’s muster list and emergency procedures
Take reasonable care for their own health and safety and for that of others who may be affected by their acts or omissions
Cooperate with management on health and safety matters Use correctly all work items provided by the Company, including personal protective equipment, in accordance with training and instructions
Not interfere with or misuse anything provided for health, safety, or welfare ·
Abide by environmental protection rules and regulations and actively participate in the reduction, reuse, and recycling schemes in place All employees shall participate actively in all HSEQ activities and promote safe practices as part of an integrated management approach.

title: Admissions Counselor I - King Road
company: MALVERN INSTITUTE FOR PSYCHIATRIC & ALCOHOLIC STUDIES
description:
Malvern Treatment Centers is currently looking for an Admissions Counselor I. 12 hour shifts (7:00am-7:30pm with some 9:00am-9:30pm and 11:00am-11:30pm) and one weekend per month commitment. Shift differentials available.

Position Summary: The Admissions Counselor I provides telephonic and in person risk assessment and crisis intervention, initial contact with referral sources and potential patients, coordinates the referral and intake process, completes all required computer data entry, facilitates the admission process and maintains communication with referral sources, families, patients and unit staff. The Admissions Counselor I collaborates with multiple disciplines to discuss placement of referrals.

Summary of Essential Position Functions:

  • Providing telephonic phone support to assists patients access treatment and referral sources.
  • Review of clinical documentation submitted by outside agencies.
  • Identifies and provides written assessment of patients on admission. Documents current needs/problems and past medical, psychiatric, drug and alcohol history. Assessment addresses bio-psychosocial needs.
  • Identifies appropriateness of admissions by using established medical criteria.
  • Explains the consent and intake forms and obtains patient signatures for each form.
  • Completes intake assessments and enters the information from the interview into the correct EMR fields.
  • Verifies insurance through eligibility portals to ensure patient’s are insured.
  • Creates patient charts by adding demographics and diagnosis to the billing system.
  • Obtains insurance authorizations from the insurance companies and documents the authorization information accurately and relays the information to the appropriate department i.e.- billing, utilization management, and nursing.
  • Responds to and directs emergency situations as necessary.
  • Communicates pertinent clinical information for unit hand-off.
  • Works positively and cooperatively with other team members to facilitate good patient care. This includes clear interdepartmental communication to include notification to nursing and clinical aides of expected admissions time and notification to nursing of the substance the patient is using.
  • Prepares and certifies the accuracy of the morning and midnight census.
  • Works with the clinical staff to appropriately facilitate room moves to accommodate new referrals.
  • Participates in continuing education (in- services & other trainings) to reach professional growth.
  • Follows all infection control practices.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
